info.text:
# Horse Riding Classic

## What does randomization do to this game?

Apples stop being something you keep. Picking one up sends a check to the
multiworld instead of adding to your total, and the apples that open the gates
between areas arrive as items from other players' worlds. Riding to a known
apple no longer opens the map; someone else finding one does.

The twelve NPCs and quests that reveal hidden apple caches (the wizard, the
crystals, the casino roulette, the gorge race and the rest) are locked behind
their own items. Receiving the item is necessary but not sufficient: you still
have to actually beat the race, win the jackpot or kill the wizard before that
NPC's apples appear.

Five more NPCs guard a single apple each rather than a cache, and they are
locked the same way: the dentist, Doctor Evil, the construction horse, the mole
miner, and the bear asleep in the forest cave, whose item is Bear Spray. An NPC
you cannot talk to yet wears a red cross instead of an exclamation mark, and
riding into them does nothing at all. That is deliberate. Most of these
conversations happen once and replace the NPC with someone who has nothing left
to give, so being allowed to have them early would cost you the apple for the
rest of the run.

The crystal puzzle in the forest will not turn until `Crystals` arrives, for the
same reason.

The nineteen horses caged in the glue factory are checks too, in every
configuration. Freeing one needs the Tooth Sharpener so your horse can chew
through the wires.

Breeding a faster horse normally happens every ten apples you pick up. Here it
happens every ten apples you *receive*, so a smaller apple pool would quietly
mean a slower horse for the whole run. `Breeding Time` items make up the
difference: one for every five apples missing from the pool, plus a rolled share
of the carrots. Receiving one sends you straight to the breeding screen, and if
several arrive at once they queue up rather than collapsing into one. Taking the
golden apple ends the queue, so apples other players find afterwards do not
interrupt a sweep of the last checks.

As a last resort, the rebel general at the final race will not start it for a
horse that cannot win. Talk to them on a slow horse and they breed you a better
one instead, as many times as it takes. A run cannot end up stranded at the
finish line for want of speed.

## What is the goal?

The golden apple behind the grate in the glue factory.

The grate opens after the rebel martyr appears and blows it up, and your yaml
chooses what makes them appear:

- **apples_received**: receive `apple_goal_requirement` apples from the
  multiworld.
- **apples_collected**: pick up `apple_goal_requirement` apples in game. In
  this mode only, `include_horses` can additionally require all 19 horses freed.

Both modes use the same `apple_goal_requirement`, which defaults to 80.

## Which items can be in another player's world?

All of them: apples, the seventeen unlocks, the Tooth Sharpener, Breeding Time,
and carrots.

## What does another world's item look like in this game?

There is no in-world representation. Checks are reported through the mod's
overlay and message log rather than by changing what the apple looks like.

## Locations

118 in every configuration:

- 99 apples, one per apple in the game other than the golden one.
- 19 glue factory cages.

The golden apple is the goal rather than a location.

tutorials.text:
# Horse Riding Classic Setup Guide

## Required software

- Horse Riding Classic on Steam (Windows, x64).
- [BepInEx 5.4.23.x, `BepInEx_win_x64`](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases).
- The Horse Riding Classic Archipelago plugin release zip.

There is **no separate client to run.** The Archipelago connection is built into
the plugin, so the game connects to the room by itself.

## Installing

1. Find the game folder: in Steam, right click the game, then
   Manage -> Browse local files.
2. Extract BepInEx into that folder, so `winhttp.dll` sits next to
   `Horse Riding Classic.exe`. Launch the game once and quit, which creates the
   `BepInEx/` subfolders.
3. Extract the plugin zip into the same game folder. It is laid out to merge, so
   the plugin lands in `BepInEx/plugins/`.

## Connecting

Launch the game and press **F1** to open the Archipelago panel. Fill in the
server address, port, slot name and password, then Connect.

Credentials can also be pre-filled without launching the game, by editing
`BepInEx/config/com.barretglass.hrc.archipelago.cfg` after the first run.

You must connect before starting or continuing a game. Your save file is chosen
by the room you are connected to, so the mod does not know which file to load
until it has connected at least once.

## Save files

**Your vanilla save is never touched.** Modded saves live in their own folder
under `%USERPROFILE%\AppData\LocalLow\Juice Cube\Horse Riding Classic\AP\`, one
folder per seed and slot.

Practical consequences:

- Reconnecting to the same room always resumes the same save, even if the
  host has moved it to a different address or port.
- Connecting to a *different* seed or slot returns you to the main menu and
  starts that run fresh. Your other run is kept, not deleted; reconnect to that
  room later and it resumes.
- If you lose connection mid-game you can keep playing. Checks are recorded
  locally and sent when you reconnect.

## Configuring your yaml

Generate a template from the Archipelago launcher, or on the website's options
page. The settings worth knowing:

| Option | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `goal_condition` | `apples_received` | What opens the grate. |
| `apple_goal_requirement` | 80 | Used by both goal conditions. |
| `include_horses` | false | Only applies in `apples_collected` mode. |
| `desert_access` | 20 | Apples received to open each area gate. |
| `farm_access` | 40 | |
| `city_access` | 60 | |
| `factory_access` | 80 | |

The access thresholds count apples **received from the multiworld**, not apples
you collect.

Two things generation will refuse, because they cannot be satisfied:

- Any access threshold above `apple_goal_requirement`, in any seed. This is the
  easy mistake: lowering the goal to 40 and leaving `city_access` at its default
  of 60.
- **In a solo seed only**, an access threshold above what this world alone can
  supply before that gate. On the default thresholds that limit is 22, 42, 64
  and 87 for desert, farm, city and factory. The error message names the number.

The second one does not apply in a multiworld, because your apples are placed in
other players' worlds as often as your own, so nothing about your own map limits
how many you can receive. A setting that is refused solo is often perfectly fine
once there is a second game in the room.

If you are generating a **solo** seed at the defaults, note that
`factory_access` sits exactly on its ceiling there, which means all 80 apples
have to be placed before the factory. It generates, but it is the tightest
configuration in the game. Lowering `factory_access` to around 70 gives fill
plenty of room without changing how the run feels.

notes.text:
## Locations
* Apples
* Horses in the glue factory

## Items
* Apples
* NPC Unlocks
* Tooth Sharpener (allows for wire cutting to free horses in the glue factory)

## Goal
* Can pick one of two:
  * A customizable number of apple items received gives access to finish
  * A customizable number of apple locations checked gives access to finish.
* For either goal can optionally require freeing the horses in the glue factory

## Other Features
* Set a custom number of apples to access each area

## Downloads
BepInEx download: [BepInEx 5.4.23.x, `BepInEx_win_x64`](https://github.com/BepInEx/BepInEx/releases)

Setup:
1. Find the game folder: in Steam, right click the game, then
   Manage -> Browse local files.
2. Extract BepInEx into that folder, so `winhttp.dll` sits next to
   `Horse Riding Classic.exe`. Launch the game once and quit, which creates the
   `BepInEx/` subfolders.
3. Extract the plugin zip into the same game folder. It is laid out to merge, so
   the plugin lands in `BepInEx/plugins/`.
4. Once you have a multiworld to connect to, open the game and connect. Press F1 to hide the connection window.
